about_the_game:
Enter the Isle. Escape with your soul.

⚡ Mage Escape 2000 is an early-in-development top-down co-op raid RPG where up to sixteen banished mages battle through the shattered afterlife — part dungeon crawler, part extraction thriller, all high stakes.

Every run drops you onto the Cursed Isle, a collapsing world where monsters swarm, ancient gates crumble, and rival squads hunt for the same relics. Raids last around 15 minutes, but every second is a gamble. Die, and lose it all. Escape, and your spoils live forever.

⚔ Raid. Loot. Escape.

Form a party or go it alone. Battle spectral enemies and desperate players across ruined temples, burning forests, and catacombs crawling with the lost. Loot scrolls, artifacts, and forbidden gear, each one bending the laws of death itself. Will you dive deeper for greater rewards, or flee before the Isle devours you whole?

🪄 Forge Your Legacy

Between raids, retreat to your Town hub, your sanctuary between runs. Stash rare loot in your 60-slot stash, trade with wandering vendors, and rebuild your scroll arsenal from over a hundred unique spells. Craft your loadout, master your mage, and prepare for the next descent into madness.

🧙‍♂️ Mage Escape 2000 is still in its early stages of development. I’m actively building out the core systems and refining the gameplay loop, and your feedback during this phase can directly help shape how the final game plays and feels. Join the community to share your ideas, report bugs, and have your voice heard!

✨ A Glimpse Into the Isle

Here’s a look at a few of the early abilities and tools currently playable in Mage Escape 2000.
These clips show just a small sample of the combat and survival systems that are evolving as development continues:

🌪 Cyclone Scroll

Summon a spinning vortex that pulls in enemies and tears them apart — perfect for clustering foes before unleashing your next spell.

❄️ Freeze Spell

Encase enemies in ice to stop them cold. Time it right to escape danger or set up a devastating follow-up attack.

⚡ Lightning Spell

Call down a bolt of energy that arcs between targets, crackling with raw destructive power.

🔥 Placeable Campfire

Set up a temporary campfire to heal yourself and allies mid-raid. It can be destroyed by enemies, so defend it well.
This clip also highlights the crouch mechanic, used for stealthy movement and defensive positioning.

💀 Risk Everything

Each run is a wager with your soul. The deeper you go, the richer the spoils — but the Isle never forgives greed. Only those who extract carry their legacy forward. The rest feed the ground they fall on.

🌐 Multiplayer & Systems

  • 16-player co-op lobbies (self-hosted or dedicated servers)

  • Server-authoritative combat and synchronized looting for fair play and late-join consistency

  • Voice and text chat with proximity audio for tense in-dungeon moments

  • Hundreds of spells and consumables with visual channeling, knockback physics, and cancelable ultimates

  • Lootable corpses with full inventory replication and sound-rich UI

  • Localized in 30+ languages for a global player base

The Isle remembers every soul that dares to enter. Will it remember yours?

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS *: Windows 7 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i3 or AMD Ryzen 3
  • Memory: 4 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Intel HD Graphics 4000 / NVIDIA GeForce GTX 750 / AMD Radeon R7 250 (or equivalent, supporting Vulkan or OpenGL 3.3)
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Requires a keyboard and mouse. Controller supported as well.
pc_requirements.recommended:
Recommended:
  • Requires a 64-bit processor and operating system
  • OS: Windows 10 / 11 (64-bit)
  • Processor: Intel Core i5 or AMD Ryzen 5
  • Memory: 8 MB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA GeForce GTX 3060 / AMD RX 580 or better
  • DirectX: Version 11
  • Network: Broadband Internet connection
  • Storage: 5 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX-compatible
  • Additional Notes: Runs best on dedicated GPUs. Stable 60 FPS expected at 1080p.
